episodeTitle.en: A better way to plan, build, and ship products | Ryan Singer (creator of “Shape Up")
episodeTitle.zh: 规划、构建和交付产品的更佳之道 | 瑞安·辛格（Ryan Singer，“Shape Up”创始人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Ryan Singer is one of the earliest employees and the former Head of Strategy at 37signals (the makers of Basecamp), where he spent nearly two decades refining a product development approach that helped the company build super-successful products with small teams. Based on these lessons, he wrote "Shape Up: Stop Running in Circles and Ship Work that Matters," and Ryan now works with companies of all sizes to help them escape the cycle of endless sprints, missed deadlines, and dragging projects. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 瑞安·辛格是37signals（Basecamp创始团队）的早期员工之一，曾担任战略主管近二十年。他在那里完善了一种产品开发方法，帮助公司用小团队打造出超级成功的产品。基于这些经验，他撰写了《Shape Up：停止无意义循环，交付有价值成果》一书。如今，瑞安为各类规模的公司提供支持，帮助他们摆脱无休止的冲刺周期、错过截止日期和拖延项目的困境。您将收获：

title.en: A better way to plan, build, and ship products | Ryan Singer (creator of “Shape Up")
title.zh: 规划、构建和交付产品的更佳之道 | 瑞安·辛格（Ryan Singer，“Shape Up”创始人）

summary.en: Ryan explains how Shape Up differs from Scrum/Agile by using fixed appetites instead of deadlines, bringing design, engineering, and product together to shape a plan before building. He traces the method's origins in the early days of Basecamp and David Heinemeier Hansson's 10-hours-a-week constraint, and why it helps maintain a startup way of working as a company grows. The episode is essential listening for teams exploring alternatives to traditional agile.
summary.zh: Ryan 解释了 Shape Up 与 Scrum/敏捷的区别：它用固定的“胃口”而非截止日期，并在动手前让设计、工程与产品共同“塑形”方案。他追溯了这一方法在 Basecamp 早期、以及 David Heinemeier Hansson 每周仅 10 小时约束下的起源，并说明它如何帮助公司在成长过程中保持创业式的工作方式。对于探索传统敏捷之外替代方案的团队，本期是必听内容。
